_llm_instructions: Fill in the 'project_title' and 'date_prepared' properties, and the 'value' property of each field, based on the provided project context. Reference parameters.md for global project variables.

f01_Description.label: Description
f01_Description.guidance: Provide a summary-level description of the project or phase: what it was, its purpose, and its boundaries. Keep it to a summary, and point to the project charter for detail.

f02_How_Benefits_Were_Achieved.label: How Benefits Were Achieved
f02_How_Benefits_Were_Achieved.guidance: Describe how the final product, service, or result achieved the benefits the project was undertaken to address. Identify the benefit and the evidence that it was realised, distinguishing a benefit that was realised from one that is still only expected.

f03_Benefits_Realisation_Status.label: Benefits Realisation Status
f03_Benefits_Realisation_Status.guidance: The current realisation status of each benefit, and who owns tracking it after the project team has been released. A benefit with no owner at closure is a benefit that will not be measured.

f04_How_Business_Needs_Were_Met.label: How Business Needs Were Met
f04_How_Business_Needs_Were_Met.guidance: Describe how the final product, service, or result achieved the business needs identified in the business plan.

f05_Needs_Not_Met.label: Needs Not Met
f05_Needs_Not_Met.guidance: Any business need that was not met, and what happens next now that the project is closed. A need left unstated here will be assumed met by whoever inherits the product.

f06_Scope_Objectives.label: Scope / Objectives
f06_Scope_Objectives.guidance: Describe the scope objectives needed to achieve the planned benefits of the project.

f07_Scope_Completion_Criteria.label: Scope / Completion Criteria
f07_Scope_Completion_Criteria.guidance: Document the specific and measurable criteria needed to complete the scope objectives. State each one so that it can be answered met or not met, and cross-reference the scope baseline.

f08_Scope_How_Met.label: Scope / How Met
f08_Scope_How_Met.guidance: Provide the evidence that the completion criteria were met. Give the source of the evidence, such as the document, test result, or acceptance record, and not only the conclusion drawn from it.

f09_Quality_Objectives.label: Quality / Objectives
f09_Quality_Objectives.guidance: Describe the quality objectives and criteria needed to achieve the planned benefits of the project.

f10_Quality_Completion_Criteria.label: Quality / Completion Criteria
f10_Quality_Completion_Criteria.guidance: Document the specific and measurable criteria needed to meet the product and project quality objectives.

f11_Quality_How_Met.label: Quality / How Met
f11_Quality_How_Met.guidance: Enter the verification and validation information from the product acceptance form. Cross-reference that form rather than restating it, so the two records cannot drift apart.

f12_Time_Objectives.label: Time / Objectives
f12_Time_Objectives.guidance: The planned time objectives: the approved schedule baseline duration and the planned completion date.

f13_Time_Final_Outcome.label: Time / Final Outcome
f13_Time_Final_Outcome.guidance: The actual completion date and the actual duration.

f14_Time_Variance.label: Time / Variance
f14_Time_Variance.guidance: The difference between planned and actual, in days or weeks, with the reason. Where the project finished early, say so and explain why, because an unexplained favourable variance hides a planning error just as a delay does.

f15_Time_Comments.label: Time / Comments
f15_Time_Comments.guidance: Any consequence of the time variance for the organization, such as a missed market window, and anything still open at closure.

f16_Cost_Objectives.label: Cost / Objectives
f16_Cost_Objectives.guidance: The approved cost baseline, or the total budget at completion if no baseline applies.

f17_Cost_Final_Outcome.label: Cost / Final Outcome
f17_Cost_Final_Outcome.guidance: The actual total spent at completion, stating whether it includes contingency drawn or reserve released.

f18_Cost_Variance.label: Cost / Variance
f18_Cost_Variance.guidance: The difference between planned and actual, in currency and as a percentage, with the reason.

f19_Cost_Comments.label: Cost / Comments
f19_Cost_Comments.guidance: Any consequence of the cost variance for the organization, such as a claim or a budget transfer still required, and anything still open.

f20_Risk_or_Issue.label: Risk or Issue
f20_Risk_or_Issue.guidance: The risk or issue, and where it came from. Give the reference from the risk or issue register rather than restating it.

f21_Response_and_Resolution.label: Response and Resolution
f21_Response_and_Resolution.guidance: What was done about it and how effective that was. Say plainly whether it worked.

f22_Comments.label: Comments
f22_Comments.guidance: What remains open, and who owns it after closure. An unresolved item transferred without a named recipient has not been transferred.

f23_Contracts_Closed.label: Contracts Closed
f23_Contracts_Closed.guidance: The contracts closed out, with the final value and the closure date of each. Where procurement was not used, state that plainly rather than leaving the section blank.

f24_Obligations_Discharged.label: Obligations Discharged
f24_Obligations_Discharged.guidance: The obligations, warranties, and service levels met, transferred, or still outstanding, with the holder named for each.

f25_Claims_and_Disputes_Settled.label: Claims and Disputes Settled
f25_Claims_and_Disputes_Settled.guidance: Any claim or dispute settled before closure, and any that was not. An unresolved claim is a liability the project is handing on.
